_about: ILLUSTRATIVE SEED DATA, NOT AN AUTHORITATIVE EMISSIONS INVENTORY. These are well-known, publicly documented major sources in and around Delhi, with approximate coordinates taken to neighbourhood accuracy. They exist so attribution has candidates to rank while a real registry is unavailable: CPCB and the state boards hold the authoritative consented-unit inventories, and a deployment must load those instead. Attribution output built on this seed names a plausible category and location, never a specific operator.
_coordinate_order: [longitude, latitude], WGS84, matching GeoJSON and PostGIS
_emission_prior: Relative plausibility that this source is emitting heavily when a plume is traced to it. Landfills rank highest because they burn chronically and continuously; industrial estates vary with what is running; a transport hub is a large but diffuse source.
